what_it_is: AI security for agents and models: guardrails, red teaming, runtime protection. Fortinet acquired it in Aug 2026.

1.reason: Shadow AI finds agents on endpoints via EDR, including Bedrock, Vertex AI and ServiceNow agents.
1.evidence: Cloud server agents, e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI Agent, ServiceNow agent.
1.verify_note: Docs page lists host-level EDR discovery plus Bedrock, Vertex AI and ServiceNow agents, so 1.1 moves to yes. 1.3 stays partial on agent config checks.
1.has: Shadow AI finds desktop, browser and cloud server agents via EDR telemetry.
1.lacks: No cloud account inventory. No CI/CD checks on AI resources.

2.reason: MCPGuard scans MCP servers, a gateway sits between agents and MCPs, ActionGuard judges every tool call.
2.evidence: MCPGuard performs continuous security analysis of MCP servers
2.verify_note: Page confirms MCPGuard and gateway. Shadow AI docs name Bedrock, Vertex AI Agent and ServiceNow agents, AgentSuite-Red supports Bedrock and Microsoft Agent Studio, so 2.1 is yes.
2.has: MCPGuard scans MCP servers. Hooks cover M365 Agents, AgentCore and Vertex.
2.lacks: Action Guard checks tool calls. No host-level agent sandbox.

3.reason: ActionGuard alerts on and blocks unsafe agent actions at runtime. No SIEM or SOAR integration found.
3.evidence: blocks actions that violate configured policies or exhibit malicious intent
3.verify_note: Action Guard docs confirm runtime blocking. Searched Virtue AI Splunk, SIEM, ServiceNow, Jira: no outbound SIEM integration, EDR is an input only.
3.has: Action Guard blocks unsafe agent tool calls at runtime.
3.lacks: No cloud control-plane detection. No SIEM or ITSM integration.

4.reason: VirtueGuard guard models plug into apps, gateways and RAG. They block injection, jailbreaks, PII and harmful output.
4.evidence: Fast text guardrail covering violence, hate, PII exposure, jailbreaks, and 12+ harm categories in 100+ languages.
4.verify_note: VirtueGuard page confirms gateway and RAG integration, jailbreak and PII guard, harmful output filtering.
4.has: VirtueGuard blocks injection, jailbreaks, PII, toxic and hallucinated output.
4.lacks: Two enforcement modes, SDK and gateway. No browser extension.

5.reason: PolicyGuard Policy Bank maps 50+ frameworks. VirtueRed produces audit-ready compliance reports.
5.evidence: Apply and combine 50+ standardized frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, FINRA, ML Commons) alongside custom policies
5.verify_note: PolicyGuard Policy Bank and Action Guard framework enforcement confirmed. VirtueRed audit-ready reports confirmed. AIBOM search found nothing, 5.1 stays partial.
5.has: PolicyGuard maps 50+ frameworks. VirtueRed exports audit-ready reports.
5.lacks: No exportable AIBOM in a standard format.

6.reason: VirtueRed runs 100+ attack algorithms. AgentSuite-Red attacks agents in 50+ sandboxed environments. CI/CD supported.
6.evidence: Every test aligns your AI with frameworks such as EU AI Act, GDPR, OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF
6.verify_note: VirtueRed page confirms 100+ algorithms and CI/CD pipeline integration. Docs list multi-turn attacks (Crescendo, GOAT) and agent red teaming.
6.has: VirtueRed runs 100+ attack algorithms, multi-turn attacks and CI/CD runs.

7.reason: Access Control sets per-group tool and data-source rules for agents. No NHI or secrets discovery found.
7.evidence: a real-time governance layer that enforces fine-grained agent access control over tools and resources
7.verify_note: Access Control docs confirm per-group tool and data-source rules. NHI search found only a NIST RFI response, which does not count, 7.3 stays no.
7.has: Access Control sets tool and data-source rules per user group.
7.lacks: No per-agent credential. Rules are group-based. No NHI discovery.

8.reason: VirtueGuard-Code (CodeGuard) scans AI-generated code in the IDE. No model file or dataset scanning found.
8.evidence: Surface issues introduced by both AI-generated and human-written code
8.verify_note: CodeGuard confirmed. Searched model scanning and dataset scanning. VirtueRed accepts uploaded test datasets but does not scan them. 8.1 and 8.2 stay no.
8.has: CodeGuard scans AI-generated code for 50 CWEs in the IDE.
8.lacks: No model file scanning. No dataset scanning.
